Beyond the obvious · twice-weekly edit

Unusual London events,
this week.

Discover free and affordable things to do in London this week and weekend, selected for unusual access, local character and a story worth following. Every listing is checked against the official organiser before publication.

Friday 20 November – Saturday 21 November · Last edited 19 November at 15:02

The complete edit

6 verified events
Friday 20 November4 events
Heritage & history Free

Friday 20 November, 11:00 – Saturday 21 November, 16:00

Model Railway Weekend at Croydon Clocktower

Croydon Model Railway Society fills the Clocktower's civic hall with layouts inspired by the borough, alongside hands-on Brio tracks for younger visitors.

Venue
Braithwaite Hall, Croydon Town Hall
Address
Katharine Street, Croydon, CR9 1ET
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Local culture Free

12:30–18:00

Radical Rediscovery III: What Survives?

A free archival exhibition traces fifty years of Black and Asian theatre through rare ephemera, oral histories, carnival costumes and the legacy of Naseem Khan's landmark 1976 report.

Venue
London Performance Studios, Studios 3 and 4
Address
Penarth Centre, Penarth Street, London, SE15 1TR
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Local culture Free; optional retiring collection

13:00–14:00

Anna Phillips: Rhapsodie Harp Recital

Welsh harpist Anna Phillips closes her album tour with an intimate lunchtime programme of Bach, Guridi, Mathias, Grandjany and a Welsh folk-song arrangement.

Venue
Welsh Church of Central London
Address
30 Eastcastle Street, London, W1W 8DJ
Access
Booking recommended
Check official details ↗
Community Free

17:00–19:30

Illuminate Bermondsey & Rotherhithe Lantern Procession

A neighbourhood-made lantern procession moves from The Blue to Southwark Park with a samba band, then lights the bandstand for an evening finale of local music.

Venue
The Blue Market
Address
4 Market Place, Southwark Park Road, London, SE16 3UQ
Access
Drop in
Check official details ↗
Saturday 21 November2 events
Community Free

11:00–15:00

Discover Your Mosque Open Day

East London Mosque welcomes first-time and non-Muslim visitors for guided tours, conversation, tea and an exhibition confronting Islamophobia and harmful stereotypes.

Venue
London Muslim Centre, Entrance 1
Address
46 Whitechapel Road, London, E1 1JX
Access
Booking required
Check official details ↗
Heritage & history £5 standard; £2.50 low-income

19:00–20:30

Rebel Footprints: Radical London Book Launch

David Rosenberg launches the third edition of his guide to London's radical geographies, linking suffragettes, Chartists, trade unionists and hidden sites of protest.

Venue
Housmans Bookshop
Address
5 Caledonian Road, London, N1 9DX
Access
Booking required
